question: For first-trimester medical MTP, the standard WHO regimen is mifepristone 200 mg orally on Day 1, followed by misoprostol 800 mcg vaginally or sublingually 24–48 hours later.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is actually correct. Mifepristone 200 mg orally on Day 1 followed by misoprostol 800 mcg (vaginal, sublingual, or buccal) 24–48 hours later is the WHO-recommended combined regimen for medical MTP up to 9–10 weeks. Review the first-trimester MTP methods section.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. This is the standard combined medical abortion regimen: mifepristone 200 mg blocks progesterone receptors (softens and primes the cervix, sensitises myometrium), then misoprostol 800 mcg completes uterine evacuation. The 24–48 hour interval is essential.
